subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Rob,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid. Leaving a geology degree to wash kegs at Otter Creek, then betting a whole brewery on one hazy beer that bartenders kept saying would never sell, is conviction that took years to look correct.

I'm building an AI teaching assistant at Middlebury, so I'm hungry to learn and would love to know how you told the difference between the market being wrong and you being wrong. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: Applied Math Sophomore Building an AI Teaching Assistant
body:
Hi Jonathan,

Max here, 20, Middlebury sophomore building an AI teaching assistant.

Spending nine years building the company positioned against Nvidia, then handing them the LPU and joining, is a harder call than staying independent or selling early.

What did you learn about inference that made the outside bet stop being right?

10 minutes? I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: 20 Year Old Who Turned Down Money for His AI Teaching Assistant
body:
Hi Amjad,

I'm Max, 20, studying applied math. I built an AI teaching assistant, won $5K for it in a pitch competition, and we turned down money to keep building it ourselves.

Killing Teams for Education in 2023 because the economics did not work, after being a founding engineer at Codecademy, was the unsentimental call and it cost you the teachers who trusted you.

Agents changed what a classroom product costs to run. Would you rebuild it now, or is education still the wrong business?

If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: 20 Year Old Who Cold Called His Way Through College
body:
Hi Eric,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a sophomore studying applied math. Splitting the chief executive job with Karim Atiyeh at a $44 billion company is the opposite of what founders usually do at that point, which is take more of it.

I made $30k cold calling small businesses to help pay for school, so I'm hungry to learn and would love to know which decisions you two now expect to disagree on. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
